_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_status: SESSION 56 (Star Treader): the long UC-CUR ids are now clean SUBJ + Z + number ids (e.g. BIOL Z9001) — DONE and live everywhere. You said 'go', and the full re-mint landed in one window: 4,053 ids re-keyed in the database + the dashboard data, verified exact by checksum (0 leftovers). 'Z' means a curator/auto-minted course that still needs faculty attention. Two things are deliberately left for next session (they don't block anything): brand-new merges still get the old-style id until we wire the auto-namer (they still work), and the audit chips won't show on the re-keyed rows until the auditor re-runs. Next big curation lever waiting on you: the 🏷 title-similarity pass 2 (~5,457 groups). Hard-refresh to see the Z ids in the Course Crosswalk.

Wire a one-click revert affordance for an individual auto-merged row (whole-cohort revert = delete reviewer_email='automerge-v1@bot'). Consider the ⚙ auto-merged chip on the CSR/CER if they surface merged identities.
